summary: The complete composed scene keeps the grounded crouch, supported palm, neck extension and short stream-to-mouth contact. Diagonal organization changes screen layout only; leaf-filtered light and reflected fill preserve the readable interaction.

body_ownership.reason: The head, mouth, and supporting palm all belong to the same adult woman; no second actor intervenes.
prompt_evidence: an adult woman with understated Korean-style beauty
one palm resting on its rim
her head tilted back and chin raised

joint_chain_and_reach.reason: Crouching lowers the pelvis and head to below the faucet; neck extension raises the chin and aligns the open mouth with the downward stream.
prompt_evidence: she crouches beside a shallow outdoor basin
her head tilted back and chin raised
her open mouth just below the downward-facing faucet outlet

support_and_balance.reason: Grounded heels support the crouch and the basin rim gives the resting palm a stable secondary support.
prompt_evidence: one palm resting on its rim

contact_and_space.reason: The projecting outlet extends clear of the basin and sits above open lips; the short downward water stream enters the mouth while spill falls into the basin.
prompt_evidence: A narrow stream falls a few centimeters from the spout and enters her parted lips
The projecting faucet stays beside her cheek

visibility_and_projection.reason: The elevated frontal camera shows the tilted face and short falling stream; the loose diagonal organizes the face and spout without relocating their contact. Reflected light keeps the mouth visible under the faucet.
prompt_evidence: a high viewpoint looking downward, slightly in front of her
leaving her upturned face and the stream-to-mouth contact visible
pale concrete reflects soft light onto her lifted face
